outcome_analysis: Very little is public about Yoneda Research. YC lists it as Active in Winter 2020 from Nairobi with a team of 30 and a single founder with an MIT math and computer science bio. Its website now states an aging and organ resurrection research mission with no product, customers or funding disclosed. No shutdown or exit was found, so the story is unknown rather than failed.
notes: Identity caveat: searches link founder Lewis Wanjohi and the Winter 2020 batch to Tambua Health (a Nairobi acoustic stethoscope startup), whose YC page is a separate listing and which a directory says now appears as Yoneda Health. That directory is a secondary source and I did not confirm the link to this slug. Tambua funding listed by aggregators (100K Backstage Accelerator March 2019, 150K YC March 2020, undisclosed Ventures Platform and Future Africa seed 2020, total about 250K) is therefore NOT recorded as rounds here. Searches for Yoneda Research funding returned only the unrelated Yoneda Labs (YC W24, San Francisco, AI for chemistry). No dated competitor sources were found for this listing, so the competitor list is empty. Defensibility and takeover ratings are null because nothing is known.
